name: my-ai-api
description: my-ai API on oci-apps — one polyglot container: OpenAI /v1 + Ollama /api + Anthropic /v1/messages mimic backed by OpenRouter (no Claude subscription, no metered Anthropic key), with a vendored Headroom (Apache-2.0) compression hop and a savings dashboard. Sibling of claude-superset-api; the agent face for this stack is goose (my-ai wraps goose, claude-superset keeps claude-cli). Internal WG-only sidecar, never public.

ports._goosed_doc: goosed = goose agent ACP/REST+SSE server (goose serve, X-Secret-Key auth, WireGuard-only)

secrets._goose_server_secret_key_doc: X-Secret-Key header required by all goosed ACP requests. Comes from .secrets env_file (src/secrets.yaml). If unset the goosed process is skipped at startup.

runtime._model_aliases_comment: requested-id → OpenRouter slug. Callers pick a model per request; unknown/absent ids fall back to `model` (passthrough also works — OpenRouter accepts arbitrary slugs, so goose can send any OpenRouter model id directly). No Claude aliases here: this stack does not route Claude.
runtime._upstream_comment: OpenRouter is the single upstream (start here). The Node front forwards compressed OpenAI-shaped chat requests to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with the container's OPENROUTER_API_KEY (from src/secrets.yaml). The Anthropic /v1/messages face is a shape-translation shim so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=<my-ai-api> clients also land on OpenRouter — NOT Claude.

upstream._passthrough_auth_comment: false = the container injects OPENROUTER_API_KEY; clients may send any placeholder Authorization (ignored). true = forward the client's own key (transparent, like claude-superset-api's anthropic proxy face).

runtime._sessions_comment: Cross-device session store for goose sessions (WG-only). Devices push recent goose session .jsonl here; any device can list/GET them to restore. dir is under container HOME; keep = max sessions retained per device.

gateway._comment: Non-secret gateway env vars. Secrets (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, MATTERMOST_TOKEN) come from .secrets env_file via secrets.yaml.
